quotes.text: In the '80s and '90s, Australian duo Dead Can Dance released a bunch of albums of rapturous, evocative music that drew on traditions from across the world. Their music never fit comfortably into any goth, post-punk, art-rock, or dream-pop categories.

Dead Can Dance's new single is "Our Day Will Come," a hypnotic ode to solidarity between Irish and Palestinian people. It's got the tingly sweep of their old music, combined with a certain world-weary determination.
